blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Impeachment Court Presiding Officer Sen. Chiz Escudero on Tuesday expressed hope that the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte will conclude before Christmas or New Year. “If I were to be asked, of course, in a perfect world, I hope the impeachment trial, whichever side wins or loses, will be concluded before Christmas or New Year,” Escudero told reporters in an interview at the Senate. His reason: “So we can face a new chapter in the coming year, rather than having to revisit this again in 2027.” “Again, whichever side prevails, I hope we can overcome […]...
